data.name: Void Swarm
data.detailed_description:
Void Swarm

Enter the Void. Survive the Swarm. Evolve with every defeat.

Void Swarm is a fast-paced arcade space shooter that blends classic aerial combat with survivor-style progression. Pilot your fighter from a behind-the-ship perspective, tear through massive enemy swarms, and collect energy to upgrade your weapons while fighting to stay alive.

Death is not the end. Every run earns resources that let you unlock permanent upgrades, purchase more powerful ships, and prepare for your next mission.

Story

Humanity discovered a mysterious region of space known only as the Void, home to an ancient collective intelligence capable of consuming entire star systems and transforming them into endless fleets of warships.

The war was already lost... until scientists discovered that destroyed enemies left behind strange energy fragments. This energy could be integrated into human technology, allowing pilots to evolve their ships beyond conventional limits.

You are part of Project Phoenix, an experimental program that reconstructs your consciousness after every failed mission. Every defeat provides valuable combat data. Every run makes you stronger. Every return brings you one step closer to the heart of the Swarm.

But the more Void energy you absorb, the thinner the line becomes between the pilot... and the enemy.

Features

  • 🚀 Fast-paced arcade space combat with a behind-the-ship perspective.

  • 💥 Fight through massive enemy swarms and survive increasingly intense waves.

  • ⚡ Collect energy orbs to upgrade your ship during each run.

  • 🔧 Spend earned resources on permanent upgrades between missions.

  • 🛸 Unlock and pilot a variety of ships, each with unique stats and playstyles.

  • 🎯 Build powerful upgrade combinations and adapt your strategy every run.

  • 🌌 Uncover the mystery of the Void as you push deeper into enemy territory.

One more run. One more upgrade. One step closer.

The Swarm evolves.

So do you.

How far will you go before you become part of the Void?
